programs.name: Emerging Leaders Series (Sophomore Insight)
programs.notes: GS's sophomore-tier insight/diversity summit (the Possibilities Series is the first-year program and its 2025-26 cycle is already closed). Class-of-2029 sophomores should apply here for the 2026-27 cycle. Diversity-oriented (Black, Hispanic/Latinx, Native American, LGBTQ+, women). No clean historical open date located; watch the Emerging Leaders Series page. Diversity eligibility restrictions may apply.

programs.name: Early Insights Program (Freshman/Sophomore)
programs.notes: Virtual multi-session series for freshmen/sophomores that feeds the first stage of Summer Analyst recruiting. Secondary sources indicate prior cycles opened roughly Feb-Mar; no dated primary source for an open date found, so left unverified with the careers page as a watch target. Targets underrepresented populations (Black, female, Hispanic/Latinx, LGBTQ+).

programs.name: Richard B. Fisher Scholarship Program (Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Diversity-only: open to Black, Hispanic, Native American and LGBT sophomores/juniors (min 3.0 GPA). $15,000 scholarship + summer internship; applied for by indicating eligibility on the Summer Analyst application. Opens on the Summer Analyst app timeline (sophomore spring). No dated open source found; watch careers page.

programs.name: Spring Insight Week (Freshman/Sophomore)
programs.notes: Early-insight week for freshmen/sophomores across lines of business. No dated open source located; watch the Spring Insights program page. Open to all (not diversity-restricted).

programs.name: Advancing Black Pathways Fellowship (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Diversity-only: six-week paid summer fellowship for sophomores committed to advancing underrepresented groups; feeds the Summer Analyst pipeline. Single sourced cycle: the 2024-12-13 date is an open-by upper bound from a deadline announcement, not a confirmed open date (the application was known to be open on or before that date; the true open may be earlier). Prediction 2026-12-11 is the nearest Friday to that anchor; treat as approximate.

programs.name: Winning Women Early Insight Program
programs.notes: Women-focused two-day early-insight conference (overviews + interviews) with consideration for internship opportunities. No dated open source located; watch JPM students careers page.

programs.name: Investment Banking Sophomore / Freshman-Sophomore Insights
programs.notes: BofA runs freshman/sophomore front-office insight and Sophomore Summer Analyst tracks (IB, Global Markets, Research), applied through the campus site with rolling review. No dedicated stable program URL and no dated open source; watch the campus/programs pages. (Distinct from the community-focused Student Leaders program, which is not IB.)

programs.name: Early ID Leadership Program (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Sophomore program (current sophomores in a 4-yr degree): virtual mentorship, technical training and interview prep feeding the Summer Analyst process. Cycle mapping: the Spring 2026 application (open in February, closed Feb 27-28, 2026 per Villanova career-services post dated 2026-02-13) prepped for the 2027 Summer Analyst interview process — i.e., it fed THIS target_summer=2027 pipeline, which is therefore now closed. '2026': '2026-02-01' is a month-precision anchor (Citi does not publish an exact open date; the app was confirmed open in February 2026, and the late-Oct-2025 Bentley item was a career-center repost, not the actual open). Confidence medium = one sourced cycle. The next Early ID cycle (~Feb 2027) would feed the Summer 2028 pipeline, a separate entry. Watch the Pre-Internships / Early ID page.

programs.name: Sophomore Springboard / Discovery Programme
programs.notes: Sophomore Springboard event plus the Discovery Programme (open to students ~2 years from graduation), both feeding internship consideration. No dated open source located; watch the Springboard sign-up and Discovery pages.

programs.name: dbAchieve Sophomore Insight (US)
programs.notes: dbAchieve is DB's selective sophomore insight/internship program; DB also runs a 'Develop with Deutsche Bank' 2-day experience (Nov & Mar). No dated open source located; watch the US Insight Programmes page.

programs.name: Sophomore Insights / Tomorrow's Talent
programs.notes: UBS runs a sophomore-focused early-insight/diversity pathway ('Tomorrow's Talent') that feeds Summer Analyst interviews. Secondary sources suggest prior diversity-pathway apps opened ~Jan-Feb; no dated primary source, so left unverified. Watch early-careers page.

programs.name: Corporate & Investment Banking Sophomore Diversity Summit
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented sophomore summit / Diversity Early Insights feeding early interview consideration ahead of the general application. No dated open source located; watch early-careers page.

programs.name: Discovery Day & Spring Insight Programs (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Early-insight programs for first/second-year students (Discovery Day, Spring Insight, plus an LGBTQ+ Sophomore Insights track). 2024-25 cycle was live by 2024-09-17 with an apply-by of 2024-09-22 (career-center repost; month/September precision). Single sourced cycle -> medium. Prediction 2026-09-15 is the nearest Tuesday to the prior open; treat as approximate. This is an early-fall opener, so it is near-term.

programs.name: Sophomore Diversity Leadership Summit / Women's Symposium
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented: Sophomore Diversity Leadership Summit and an invite-only Women's Sophomore Symposium; pipeline to first-round IB interviews (~March). A separate Evercore Diversity Scholarship ($15k + SA offer) opens ~February. No dated open source located; watch US students & graduates page.

programs.name: Sophomore Diversity Program / Women's Event
programs.notes: Diversity-only: invite-only sophomore diversity day and a Sophomore Women's Event (Black, Hispanic/LatinX, Native American, LGBTQ, Veteran sophomores; min 3.0 GPA). No dated open source located; watch students careers page.

programs.name: Leadership Development Program (Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Sophomore day-program (successor to the Young Leaders Diversity Program) intended to broaden the applicant pool from underrepresented groups but open to all. Prior deadlines fell in mid-January; the 2025 LDP flyer was posted Oct 2024. No clean open date, left unverified; watch the explore-opportunities page.

programs.name: Advisory Diversity Prep Program (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Diversity-only flagship early-insight program for women and underrepresented minorities (Black, Hispanic/Latino, Native American, LGBTQ+), run in sophomore spring as the primary summer-internship feeder. Monitor careers page starting Dec/Jan. No dated open source located.

programs.name: PJT Forward (Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Diversity-only sophomore program for underrepresented backgrounds; acceptance typically fast-tracks candidates past first-round technicals. Prior cycles opened ~Dec/Jan. No dated open source located; watch the Students page / Workday board.

programs.name: Sophomore Leadership Program / Sophomore Women's Program
programs.notes: US Global Advisory Sophomore Leadership Program (SLP) plus a Sophomore Women's Program (SWP) — an immersion with January in-person programming in NYC. SWP deadline was ~Nov 24 in the 2024-25 cycle; no clean open date, left unverified. Watch the opportunities page.

programs.name: Early Insights (Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Early Insights program open to first-years/sophomores/juniors, encouraging Black, Latinx and Native American students interested in finance; runs coffee chats and diversity meetups. No dated open source located; watch careers page.

programs.name: Sophomore FOCUS Program
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented sophomore program (Fostering Opportunity, Collaboration and Upward Success): virtual programming + NYC networking reception and interviews for the Summer Analyst class. Targets Black, Hispanic/Latinx, Native American, LGBTQ+ and students with disabilities. The annual event ran ~Feb (2025); no clean open date, left unverified. Watch careers page.

programs.name: Sophomore Opportunities (IB Insights Bootcamp / Showcase)
programs.notes: Sophomore suite: IB Insights Bootcamp (virtual sessions granting early access to the Summer Analyst app; secondary sources say it opens ~Sept with an Oct deadline, rolling), plus Sophomore Showcase and Diversity Fast Track (deadline ~Mar 1). No dated primary open source, so left unverified; watch the Sophomore Opportunities page. This is likely an early-fall opener.

programs.name: Investment Banking Diversity Symposium (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented sophomore IB symposium (fast-track to interviews). Bentley career-center 'Applications Now Open' post dated 2023-12-19 for the upcoming (early-2024) symposium — single sourced cycle -> medium. Prediction 2026-12-22 is the nearest Tuesday to the prior open; treat as approximate. Jefferies runs the symposium under class-year labels (e.g., 'Class of 2029').

programs.name: Rising Leaders Diversity Program / Women's Insight Day
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented: Rising Leaders Diversity Program (spanning sophomore/junior touchpoints) plus IB Women's Insight Days. No dated open source located; watch the for-students / early-careers pages.

programs.name: Bridge to Investment Banking (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Diversity/women-oriented sophomore program (also seen as 'Fast Track to Investment Banking'), a winter program feeding the Summer Analyst pipeline. No dated open source located; watch the IB early-career page.

programs.name: Ascend to Global Investment Banking (Sophomore Women)
programs.notes: Women-focused: after sophomore year, ~10 women join Baird IB (Chicago/Milwaukee/NYC) for a 10-week program with professional-development sessions. Broader IB sophomore recruiting apps open ~late December. No dated open source for Ascend; left unverified. Watch the GIB intern program page.

programs.name: Career Exploration Program (Sophomore)
programs.notes: Two-day sophomore program feeding the IB Summer Analyst track (all majors; open to all with a diversity emphasis). Both sourced cycles opened in early-mid October (LinkedIn announcement of the 10th-annual CEP in Oct 2023; the 2026 CEP was live by Oct 20, 2025 with a Oct 27 deadline; the event ran Jan 22-23, 2026). Two cycles -> high, but dates are month-level (recorded as the 1st). Prediction: opens ~early October 2026 — a near-term opener.

programs.name: Sophomore Women in Banking Program
programs.notes: Women-focused: 3-day in-person program (Mizuho | Greenhill) for sophomore women, with an accelerated interview process for the summer internship. Recurs annually (2023, 2024, 2025 postings) but no clean open date located; left unverified. Watch campus-recruiting page. Note: overlaps the 'greenhill' firm entry post-merger.

programs.name: Explore Nomura (Freshman & Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented early-insight for freshmen/sophomores (Black, Hispanic/Latino, Native American, LGBTQ+, women, veterans, students with disabilities); IB / Global Markets / Corporate exposure with SA interview consideration. The 2024 program was announced on LinkedIn in fall 2023 (recorded as 2023-10-01, month-level). Single sourced cycle -> medium; prediction ~October 2026 is approximate.

programs.name: Launch (First-Year/Sophomore Insight)
programs.notes: 'Launch' is BMO Capital Markets' early-insight program for first-year/underclassman students. No dedicated program URL and no dated open source; watch the campus-recruiting page. Existence per firm notes; details unverified.

programs.name: Sophomore Women's Event
programs.notes: Women-focused annual event for sophomores interested in summer internships (Macquarie Capital is the IB arm). No dated open source located; watch graduates-and-interns page.

programs.name: Emerging Leaders Seminar (Sophomore Diversity)
programs.notes: Diversity-oriented virtual seminar introducing IB / capital markets / research career paths and upcoming Early ID + summer internship opportunities. Encourages Black, Hispanic, Native American, female, veteran, LGBTQ+ and students with disabilities. No dated open source located; watch internships page.
